paraphrase: OPEN analyst generalization of ST I q.7 a.2 co.: for every being x and principle r, if the esse of x is received in r, then the esse of x is limited. The passage says this of a subsistent created form, whose esse is 'receptum et contractum ad determinatam naturam' so that it is not infinite simpliciter; the generalization to every received esse is the analyst's. It is the converse of STMT-ESSE-LIMITED-ONLY-THROUGH-RECEPTION.
